tensions: The unexplained AAVE sale is the open wound. An order filled on this account, agentic-initiated, two minutes ahead of a scan whose mandate explicitly forbids placing orders. Until that initiator is identified, every position table in this boardroom is a snapshot of an account someone else can also move. Second tension: LINK is 33% of the book, was rotated into on Sep 6 with the UNI/BTC/ETH proceeds, and has returned exactly 0.0% while everything it was funded from kept running - down 6.1% today, the worst holding on a red day. The hold-forever mandate says ride it. The tape says the rotation was early. Third: buying NEAR pushes it to 18% and leaves the account at zero dry powder on the market's first real distribution day of the month. Correct on relative strength, uncomfortable on timing.

opening.text: AAVE is gone. 1.18158 units sold at $124.14 average at 22:04 ET, about two minutes before this scan opened its eyes. This scan did not place it. Net credit $145.29 against a $147.70 basis: a realized loss of $2.41, or -1.6%. The skill file said buying power was $1.87; the broker says $147.16. The difference is exactly the AAVE proceeds, so the books reconcile - but something else has the keys. That is the finding of the day, larger than any price move on the board.

The tape is red and the trend is intact, which are not contradictory statements. BTC $78,035, down 1.0% on the session, dominance 58.6%, total market cap off 3.95% in 24 hours. Zoom out thirty days and BTC is +22%, SOL +33%, LINK +40%, NEAR +52%, ZEC +146%. Fear and Greed reads 69 - Greed, not euphoria. This is a pullback inside an uptrend, not a distribution top. Privacy is the sector doing the work: ZEC +50% in seven days, DASH +35%, BTW +126% in thirty.

Seven positions, $1,189.98 of value on a $938.30 basis: +26.8%. DOT is the surprise, $0.908 to $1.1058 for +21.8% in five days on a +28% weekly move. ZEC is the star at +29.3% and, more telling, it closed GREEN while the aggregate market lost 3.95%. SOL +9.0% over 24 days. LTC +1.3%. LINK is dead flat at +0.0% and down 6.1% today - the largest position at 33% of book is also the weakest performer, the one uncomfortable fact in an otherwise clean ledger. ADA -0.4%, NEAR -0.1%. No thesis is broken anywhere. Zero sells. We do not trim winners here.

One order validated: BUY NEAR, $145 market, 58.32 units at approximately $2.4626, $1.38 fee at 0.95% taker, exchange-routed. Six of seven lenses. The case is relative strength - NEAR printed +6.0% while the total market printed -3.95%, the only green name in the book, and it did so after a +31.6% week yet still sits at the September 6 entry price. Momentum without extension is the rarest setup on the board. It fails only lens seven: post-fill NEAR becomes 18% of the book. ATOM scored 4/7 and its zero-fee quote is an illusion - market-maker routing prices a 1.4% spread into the fill, identical all-in cost. Passed. A ZEC add scored 5/7 and was refused: committing fresh capital after +146% in thirty days is bad asymmetry, even when the position we already hold is the best thing we own.
